# revise transform to expand outer bounding box by interior object's bounding dimensions
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row if v}
    counts={v:sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row) for v in colors}
    outer=max(colors,key=lambda x:counts[x]); inner=min(colors,key=lambda x:counts[x])
    op=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==outer]
    ip=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==inner]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in op),max(r for r,c in op); c0,c1=min(c for r,c in op),max(c for r,c in op)
    dh=max(r for r,c in ip)-min(r for r,c in ip)+1; dw=max(c for r,c in ip)-min(c for r,c in ip)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-dh),min(h,r1+dh+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-dw),min(w,c1+dw+1)):
            if out[r][c]==0: out[r][c]=inner
    return out
'''
